# meshoptimizer

Vendored from [zeux/meshoptimizer](https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer) at
commit `f843aae0b3070306bd2aeef43ffcf09509fee526`.

Adriatic retains the public header and the implementation units needed for
vertex remapping, vertex-cache optimization, and vertex-fetch optimization.
